# SHARDING_FILTER stage and chunkSkips — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for SHARDING_FILTER stage and chunkSkips. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-23 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## Structure and components

- [statement] In the MongoDB `master` `DistinctScan` implementation checked on 2026-10-21, shard-filtering an individual orphan document increments that stage's `chunkSkips`, while skipping orphan chunks increments the separate `orphanChunkSkips` statistic. Therefore, a `chunkSkips` field by itself does not prove that the plan contains a `SHARDING_FILTER` stage. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-21) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/exec/classic/distinct_scan.cpp · keywords: SHARDING_FILTER stage and chunkSkips · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/, https://help.aliyun.com/en/dts/support/how-do-you-clean-up-orphaned-documents-in-a-mongodb-sharded-cluster

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] MongoDB says explain fields used internally may be undocumented and that listed output fields can change, so treat the exact presence and shape of `chunkSkips` as diagnostic output rather than a stable application interface. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/ · keywords: SHARDING_FILTER stage and chunkSkips · also: https://help.aliyun.com/en/dts/support/how-do-you-clean-up-orphaned-documents-in-a-mongodb-sharded-cluster

## Facts and statements

- [statement] SHARDING_FILTER is MongoDB's execution stage for filtering orphan documents from a shard. For a sharded explain, execution statistics are reported per accessed shard, and chunkSkips appears among the stage statistics. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/ · keywords: SHARDING_FILTER stage and chunkSkips · also: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dts/support/how-do-you-clean-up-orphaned-documents-in-a-mongodb-sharded-cluster
- [statement] chunkSkips counts orphan documents filtered by SHARDING_FILTER on the current shard for that execution. Alibaba's example shows two input documents filtered and chunkSkips: 2; Huawei describes the field as the number of orphaned documents on the current shard. (high confidence) Sources: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dts/support/how-do-you-clean-up-orphaned-documents-in-a-mongodb-sharded-cluster ; https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/drs_faq/drs_09_0101.html — https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dts/support/how-do-you-clean-up-orphaned-documents-in-a-mongodb-sharded-cluster · keywords: SHARDING_FILTER stage and chunkSkips · also: https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/es-us/drs_faq/drs_09_0101.html
- [statement] Huawei's collection-wide check uses find() with explain("executionStats") and warns that it scans all documents on all shard nodes in a collection, can take a long time, and causes query pressure on the DB instance. Sources: https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/drs_faq/drs_09_0101.html — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/ · keywords: SHARDING_FILTER stage and chunkSkips · also: https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/es-us/drs_faq/drs_09_0101.html
- [statement] MongoDB defines `SHARDING_FILTER` as the execution stage that filters out orphan documents from shards. The MongoDB explain-results page lists chunkSkips as a field of the stage; Alibaba Cloud and Huawei Cloud documentation describe it as the count of orphaned documents filtered out in the SHARDING_FILTER stage. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/ ; https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dts/support/how-do-you-clean-up-orphaned-documents-in-a-mongodb-sharded-cluster — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/ · keywords: SHARDING_FILTER stage and chunkSkips · also: https://help.aliyun.com/en/dts/support/how-do-you-clean-up-orphaned-documents-in-a-mongodb-sharded-cluster
- [statement] For a collection-wide orphan check, Alibaba Cloud instructs users to run an unfiltered `find().explain("executionStats")` and check the output for each shard; Huawei Cloud gives the same unfiltered find with explain("executionStats") (adding a secondary read preference and local read concern) and says to run it once per collection. Both say a nonzero SHARDING_FILTER chunkSkips means orphaned documents exist on that shard, and Alibaba's example shows the counter for documents filtered by SHARDING_FILTER. Sources: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dts/support/how-do-you-clean-up-orphaned-documents-in-a-mongodb-sharded-cluster ; https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/drs_faq/drs_09_0101.html — https://help.aliyun.com/en/dts/support/how-do-you-clean-up-orphaned-documents-in-a-mongodb-sharded-cluster · keywords: SHARDING_FILTER stage and chunkSkips · also: https://support.huaweicloud.com/intl/es-us/drs_faq/drs_09_0101.html
